raw_text:
Tom Okafor
Mobile Engineer, London
tom.okafor@example.com

Summary
Mobile engineer with 5 years of experience shipping consumer apps on both platforms.

Skills
React Native, TypeScript, Swift, JavaScript, GraphQL

Experience

Senior Mobile Engineer at Wander (2022 to 2026)
Led the React Native rewrite of the travel planner used by 1.2 million people.
Typed the shared codebase end to end in TypeScript.
Built native camera and offline modules in Swift.
Consumed the trip GraphQL API and owned its mobile schema.

Mobile Developer at Piccadilly Apps (2021 to 2022)
Shipped JavaScript bridges and app store releases.

Education
BSc Computer Science, University of Manchester, 2021
